## Comparison: Workday Q1 FY2027 Guidance vs. Actual Results

Workday issued guidance for its fiscal 2027 first quarter (ended April 30, 2026) in its Q4 FY2026 earnings release (filed 2026-02-24), and then reported actual results for that quarter in its Q1 FY2027 earnings release (filed 2026-05-21). Both figures come from Workday's own comparable non-GAAP guidance and actual disclosures, so they are directly comparable metrics from the same company on the same accounting basis (subscription revenue and non-GAAP operating margin) [DOC: workday_guidance.txt][DOC: workday_actual.txt].

**Subscription Revenue:**
- Guidance: $2.335 billion, representing ~13% year-over-year growth [DOC: workday_guidance.txt: "Subscription revenues of $2.335 billion, representing growth of 13%."]
- Actual: $2.354 billion, an increase of 14.3% year-over-year [DOC: workday_actual.txt: "Subscription revenues were $2.354 billion, an increase of 14.3% year-over-year."]
- Result: **Beat** — actual subscription revenue exceeded guidance by approximately $19 million (~0.8% above the guided figure), and year-over-year growth of 14.3% came in above the 13% growth guided.

**Non-GAAP Operating Margin:**
- Guidance: 30.5% of revenues [DOC: workday_guidance.txt: "Non-GAAP operating margin of 30.5%."]
- Actual: 31.8% of revenues (non-GAAP operating income of $809 million) [DOC: workday_actual.txt: "Non-GAAP operating income for the first quarter was $809 million, or 31.8% of revenues."]
- Result: **Beat** — actual non-GAAP operating margin came in 1.3 percentage points above the guided 30.5%.

Both metrics for which guidance was given (subscription revenue and non-GAAP operating margin) were exceeded by Workday's actual reported results, so on both fronts Workday beat its own previously issued guidance for the quarter.

ANSWER: Workday beat its own guidance on both metrics for Q1 FY2027: subscription revenue was $2.354B (actual) vs. $2.335B guided (13% growth guided vs. 14.3% actual growth — a beat of ~$19M/0.8%), and non-GAAP operating margin was 31.8% (actual) vs. 30.5% guided (a beat of 1.3 percentage points).
